parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, email, phone, attributes::jsonb AS attrs
FROM tc_users
WHERE COALESCE((attributes::jsonb->>'whatsappEnabled')::boolean, false) = true
  AND NULLIF(attributes::jsonb->>'whatsappExpiresAt', '')::timestamptz > NOW()
  AND COALESCE(attributes::jsonb->'whatsappDevices', '[]'::jsonb) @> to_jsonb(ARRAY[$1::integer])
  AND phone IS NOT NULL
  AND phone <> ''
